claims.statement: After the complete H-051 closure handoff, the registered human principal supplied the model-visible text 'dale connit y merge y a lo que sigue', represented as thirty-six UTF-8 bytes with SHA-256 de39c2e5820abb8eae2420d682914d4e1dccd9154ca402bb31dd12a0e87c37b6; this record makes no claim about inaccessible transport bytes.
